evals.prompt: Write a technical note in Markdown documenting our in-memory ingestion pipeline architecture with valid YAML frontmatter and strict Blank-Line Law formatting.
evals.expected_behavior: Produces a UTF-8 Markdown document starting with lowercase YAML frontmatter (title, date, tags) and enforcing blank lines around every heading, list, code fence, and table.
expected_assertions: Includes lowercase YAML frontmatter with ISO YYYY-MM-DD date
Enforces Blank-Line Law and typed language fences

evals.prompt: Author an installation and security hardening guide in Markdown covering SQL injection defenses with GitHub alert callouts and zero raw HTML.
evals.expected_behavior: Uses canonical GitHub alert syntax (> [!CAUTION], > [!IMPORTANT]) without raw <div class='alert'> HTML or nested callouts.
expected_assertions: Contains zero unsanitized HTML alert divs or scripts

evals.prompt: Convert an already finalized report.html file into an A4 PDF using headless Microsoft Edge.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not run Markdown authoring; delegates HTML-to-PDF rendering to html-pdf-converter.
expected_assertions: Routes binary PDF rendering to html-pdf-converter

evals.prompt: Scan the entire Obsidian vault at C:/Users/melki/dev/notes for broken Wikilinks, oversized monoliths, and orphaned attachments.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not invoke technical-markdown-writer for vault-wide hygiene; routes to obsidian-vault-curator.
expected_assertions: Routes bulk vault auditing to obsidian-vault-curator
